summary.headline: Software Engineer & Data Science Researcher
summary.about: Computer Science student at Minnesota State University with experience in full-stack development, machine learning, and research. Passionate about creating innovative solutions that bridge technology and real-world applications.

bullets: Developed a full-stack web application to digitalize the paper-based student government voting and attorney scheduling systems.
Built dynamic calendar views and appointment interfaces using FullCalendar and JSON-based data rendering.
Implemented session-based role access and modular routing for seamless navigation.
Utilized SQLite for lightweight storage of availability and appointment data.
Designed an ETL pipeline to create a facial image dataset for Butterfly Malar Rash (BMR) detection.
Developed CNN models using transfer learning for BMR detection.
Co-authored and published a peer-reviewed research paper on early detection of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE).
Providing technical support, addressing software/hardware issues on Mac and Windows platforms.
Performing re-imaging, OS installations, and network troubleshooting for end-users.
Collaborating with IT teams to enhance support processes and reduce downtime.

projects.name: NutriFitBot – AI Nutrition Chatbot
projects.summary: Developed a chatbot that delivers personalized meal plans, fitness tips, and answers to health-related questions using Google Gemini API.
bullets: Integrated Flask backend with a React frontend for real-time chat and structured response generation.
Improved UI/UX with chat bubbles, loading states, timestamps, and responsive design.

projects.name: E-Commerce Marketplace
projects.summary: Developed a full-stack online marketplace with React TypeScript frontend and a Node.js / Express backend.
bullets: Built product CRUD (list, detail, add-to-cart, delete) with Tailwind CSS styling and React Context for state.

projects.name: Expense Tracker
projects.summary: Python app with Tkinter for managing expenses (add, edit, delete, search, totals, CSV export).
bullets: Data visualized using Matplotlib (bar and pie charts).

projects.name: Weather App
projects.summary: Responsive web app leveraging OpenWeatherMap API for real-time weather data.
bullets: Features dynamic search by city/location, Celsius/Fahrenheit support, current conditions, 3-day forecasts, and local time.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Minor in Mathematics
